title: Glovo dovrà fornire abbigliamento tecnico, acqua e ripari ai rider (inquadrandoli come lavoratori subordinati): svolta nel food delivery
content:
Glovo dovrà fornire abbigliamento tecnico, acqua e ripari ai rider (inquadrandoli come lavoratori subordinati): svolta nel food delivery
Indice
Un terremoto giudiziario si sta abbattendo sulle fondamenta della gig economy italiana. Paolo Storari, pubblico ministero della Procura di Milano, ha espresso un parere nettamente contrario alla revoca del controllo giudiziario per caporalato disposto nei confronti di Foodinho, la branca italiana del colosso spagnolo Glovo. La richiesta di sbloccare la srl, depositata dagli avvocati dell’azienda dinanzi al giudice per le indagini preliminari Roberto Crepaldi, è stata respinta al mittente: secondo le verifiche condotte dal Nucleo tutela del lavoro dei carabinieri, i 40mila ciclofattorini impiegati sulla piattaforma lungo la Penisola continuano a percepire compensi inferiori alla soglia di povertà.
Nonostante i correttivi introdotti dalla società – che hanno stabilito una soglia minima di 3 euro a consegna e 14 euro lordi all’ora –, il sistema applicato valuta unicamente il tempo effettivo calmierato della singola corsa. In questo modo rimane del tutto privo di compenso almeno il 30% delle ore di lavoro complessivamente prestate, azzerando la retribuzione dei tempi morti che intercorrono tra una spedizione e quella successiva.
L’algoritmo opaco, i 38 milioni di contributi evasi ed il nodo della subordinazione
L’infrastruttura tecnologica che governa il lavoro dei rider rimane al centro del mirino degli inquirenti. I consulenti tecnici nominati da Paolo Storari denunciano l’assoluta mancanza di trasparenza dell’algoritmo, uno strumento software integrato nell’applicazione aziendale che esercita un potere di etero-direzione e controllo capillare sulle prestazioni. Basandosi sulle ultime disposizioni legislative e sulle recenti sentenze dell’Autorità garante della concorrenza e del mercato, la Procura evidenzia come nell’unico mese di giugno siano state calcolate oltre 342mila ore lavorative non retribuite su un campione di ventiseimila lavoratori, pari a ben 13 ore sottratte a ciascun fattorino.
Inoltre, la magistratura contesta a Foodinho un’evasione contributiva stimata in oltre 38 milioni di euro nel triennio compreso tra il 2022 e il 2024, sostenendo fermamente la tesi – appoggiata dalle sigle sindacali Usb e Nidil Cgil – che i lavoratori debbano essere inquadrati a tutti gli effetti come lavoratori subordinati. Da parte sua, la dirigenza aziendale difende il proprio modello operativo fondato sulle prestazioni autonome, ventilando il rischio di un abbandono del mercato nazionale in stile Uber Eats.
La svolta di Torino: la sicurezza diventa un costo aziendale
Parallelamente sul fronte piemontese, il Tribunale di Torino ha emesso una decisione storica in materia di salute e prevenzione sui luoghi di lavoro, resa definitiva il 20 agosto 2026. Rispondendo alle azioni promosse dalla sigla sindacale Slang Usb, i magistrati hanno stabilito che l’onere della protezione fisica dei ciclofattorini deve ricadere interamente sulle casse aziendali di Glovo.
L’azienda è stata perentoriamente obbligata a fornire ai propri collaboratori dotazioni di protezione individuali dettagliate: dalle calzature ergonomiche all’abbigliamento tecnico impermeabile o termico, passando per l’allestimento di spazi dedicati per ripararsi durante le pause e il libero accesso ai servizi igienici. Per contrastare l’esposizione al caldo estremo estivo, la piattaforma dovrà inoltre distribuire copricapi con visiera, occhiali con filtri per raggi UV, protezioni solari ad alto fattore, integrare scorte d’acqua e borracce termiche con integratori di sali minerali.
L’inerzia denunciata dai sindacati ed i precedenti giudiziari
Malgrado il carattere vincolante della sentenza torinese, i rappresentanti di Slang Usb denunciano come le prescrizioni imposte non abbiano ancora trovato una piena e concreta attuazione all’interno dell’organizzazione aziendale, sollecitando un celere intervento degli organi di vigilanza e degli ispettori del lavoro. La battaglia torinese va ad agganciarsi alla pronuncia della Corte d’Appello di giugno 2026, la quale aveva già decretato la natura subordinata dei contratti Foodinho-Glovo imponendo l’applicazione del contratto collettivo della logistica.
Una linea rigorosa adottata anche dal Tribunale di Milano che, in una causa parallela riguardante i rider operativi nelle zone di Palermo e Trapani, ha introdotto rigide valutazioni del rischio climatico. La combinazione delle sentenze di Torino e Milano stringe le piattaforme digitali all’interno di un perimetro normativo invalicabile: la flessibilità dell’era digitale non potrà più prescindere dal salario minimo, dai diritti sindacali e dalla tutela della salute.

title: Falleció un familiar: ¿cómo saber si dejó dinero en una AFP y quién puede cobrarlo?
content:
Cuando fallece un familiar, una de las preguntas que puede surgir es si tenía una cuenta en una AFP y qué ocurrió con los fondos acumulados durante su vida laboral. En el Sistema Privado de Pensiones (SPP), más de 17,000 afiliados fallecidos mantienen recursos en sus cuentas sin que se haya iniciado un trámite de pensión de sobrevivencia o herencia.
La situación cambiará desde setiembre, cuando las AFP tendrán un rol más activo para identificar estos casos, comunicar a los familiares la posible existencia de recursos y orientarlos sobre el procedimiento que corresponda.
Pero, ¿qué debe hacer una familia cuando fallece un afiliado? ¿Cómo saber si estaba afiliado a una AFP? ¿Quién puede recibir el dinero? ¿Se trata de una pensión o de una herencia?
- LEA TAMBIÉN: SBS: se acerca la hora en que clientes de bancos compartirán sus datos, ¿qué recibirán a cambio?
Primer paso: confirmar si estaba afiliado a una AFP
La primera tarea es verificar si el familiar fallecido estuvo afiliado al SPP. Para ello, se puede consultar el servicio “Herederos Informados” de la SBS o el Reporte de Situación Previsional, disponible en el portal de la Superintendencia de Banca, Seguros y AFP (SBS) a través de este link: https://servicios.sbs.gob.pe/ReporteSituacionPrevisional/Afil_Consulta.aspx.
La consulta permite conocer la AFP en la que estuvo afiliado el familiar. Una vez identificada la administradora, la familia puede contactarla para saber si existen fondos acumulados y recibir orientación sobre el trámite que corresponde.
La SBS señala que, si existen recursos, la AFP debe determinar quiénes son los posibles beneficiarios revisando el parentesco con el afiliado fallecido y verificando si se cumplen los requisitos establecidos para acceder a una pensión de sobrevivencia.
¿El dinero es una pensión o una herencia?
Esta es una de las principales diferencias que debe conocer la familia. Los fondos no necesariamente se entregan de manera automática a los herederos.
Según explica Melissa Malca Romero, coordinadora del Sistema Evaluador de Invalidez del SPP de la SBS, los familiares directos que pueden tener derecho a una pensión de sobrevivencia son el cónyuge o conviviente, los hijos y, en determinados casos, los padres. La AFP debe verificar en cada situación si se cumplen los requisitos.
Si existen personas que tienen derecho a una pensión de sobrevivencia, corresponde seguir ese procedimiento.
En cambio, los fondos pueden entregarse como herencia cuando no existen personas con derecho a una pensión de sobrevivencia. En ese caso, quienes pretendan recibirlos deben acreditar legalmente su condición de herederos mediante un testamento o una sucesión intestada.
Malca recordó que para más orientación, los usuarios pueden acceder al siguiente enlace: https://www.sbs.gob.pe/usuarios/informacion-de-pensiones/pensiones-y-beneficios/pension-de-sobrevivencia.
El abogado Oscar Ahumada, asociado de Noriega, Icaza & Cárdenas Abogados y especialista en derecho civil, explica que ante el fallecimiento del titular debe distinguirse entre ambos derechos: el de recibir una pensión de sobrevivencia y el de heredar el saldo de la cuenta.
¿Quiénes pueden recibir una pensión de sobrevivencia?
Entre los posibles beneficiarios se encuentran:
- El cónyuge del afiliado fallecido.
- El conviviente, siempre que la unión de hecho haya sido reconocida conforme a las condiciones correspondientes.
- Los hijos menores de edad.
- Los hijos mayores de edad que cumplan las condiciones previstas, como encontrarse cursando estudios superiores.
- Los hijos mayores de edad con discapacidad, según corresponda.
- Los padres, en determinados casos y cuando cumplan los requisitos establecidos.
La AFP será la encargada de verificar cada situación y señalar los documentos necesarios. Entre los documentos que pueden solicitarse se encuentran el acta de defunción y aquel que acredite el vínculo familiar, como una partida de matrimonio o de nacimiento, según el caso.
En el caso de una unión de hecho, Ahumada advierte que no basta con acreditar la convivencia de palabra: debe existir un reconocimiento notarial o judicial inscrito en los Registros Públicos.
¿Y si corresponde una herencia?
Cuando no existen beneficiarios con derecho a una pensión de sobrevivencia, el saldo de la cuenta puede pasar a formar parte de la masa hereditaria. Para ello, es necesario acreditar legalmente la condición de heredero.
Si existe un testamento, se deberá presentar el documento correspondiente. Si no lo hay, será necesario realizar una sucesión intestada.
La distribución entre varios herederos se realiza conforme a las reglas del orden sucesorio previstas en el Código Civil. Ahumada señala que los hijos y demás descendientes son herederos de primer orden; los padres y demás ascendientes, de segundo orden; y el cónyuge o sobreviviente de la unión de hecho, de tercer orden, además de los demás parientes colaterales que correspondan.
El abogado también advierte que una situación que puede generar problemas es la exclusión o disputa entre herederos, lo que puede derivar en litigios y retrasar tanto el otorgamiento de una pensión como la entrega del saldo que corresponda a la masa hereditaria.
¿Qué cambia desde setiembre?
La principal modificación es que las AFP tendrán que asumir un rol más activo y permanente para identificar, comunicar y difundir los casos de afiliados fallecidos que mantienen recursos sin que se haya iniciado un trámite.
Las AFP ya tienen identificado un primer grupo de más de 17,000 afiliados fallecidos con recursos sin trámite iniciado y deberán publicar en sus páginas web la información correspondiente.
Para los nuevos casos, las administradoras deberán realizar acciones de comunicación directa a la última dirección domiciliaria del afiliado dentro de los 15 días calendario de haber tomado conocimiento del fallecimiento. También deberán realizar difusión periódica en sus páginas web.
La publicación será semestral y acumulativa, considerando a afiliados fallecidos con más de 90 días sin trámite. Además, la SBS publicará enlaces directos a los apartados de las páginas web de las AFP para facilitar el acceso a esta información.
“El objetivo es que la familia no dependa únicamente de su propia iniciativa para conocer que podrían existir recursos o beneficios previsionales”, manifesta Melissa Malca.
¿Qué pasa si nadie reclama los fondos?
Si ningún beneficiario o heredero inicia el trámite, los fondos permanecen en la cuenta del afiliado fallecido conforme a la ley.
Precisamente, una de las finalidades de las nuevas medidas es reducir los casos que permanecen sin trámite por falta de información, de manera que las familias conozcan oportunamente la posible existencia de recursos y puedan ejercer los derechos que les correspondan.
Si una familia confirma que existen fondos, pero tiene dificultades para iniciar el procedimiento o no recibe respuesta de la AFP, puede recurrir a los canales de atención de consultas y reclamos de la administradora y de la SBS.
La recomendación, tanto para quienes buscan una pensión de sobrevivencia como para quienes deben acreditar una condición de heredero, es identificar primero qué derecho corresponde y reunir la documentación que permita demostrar el vínculo o la condición sucesoria antes de iniciar el trámite ante la AFP.
Licenciado en Ciencias de la Comunicación, con especialidad en Periodismo, por la Universidad Tecnológica del Perú, con más de 12 años de experiencia en medios de comunicación. Actualmente escribo sobre política, economía y actualidad.

title: Houston now requires air conditioning in all rentals, making cooling a housing standard
content:
In one of Texas' hottest major cities, air conditioning is no longer an optional perk for renters.
Houston City Council voted to require landlords to provide cooling in every rental unit, making AC a basic housing standard.
Here's what to know
Landlords now have 120 days — until December — to equip every rental unit with some form of cooling, according to the Houston Chronicle, whether it be central air, a window AC, or a portable unit.
Council approved the ordinance 12-2, ending Houston's longstanding "window screen exemption." Under that rule, owners could satisfy housing-code standards with screened windows and doors instead of refrigerated air.
In a city where intense summer heat can threaten people's health, that exception became increasingly notable. Going forward, a unit without AC will be handled through the normal code-enforcement system where residents can file a complaint, the health department can inspect the property, and landlords who do not fix the issue can face citations or end up in municipal court.
Backers of the change say it puts Houston in line with other big Texas cities and recognizes cooling as part of a safe, livable home rather than a luxury amenity.
More background
The change comes after several years of record summer heat, coinciding with an increase in heat-related deaths in the Houston area. Indoor cooling can make a major difference for older adults, children, and people with health conditions that get worse in extreme heat.
A 2023 survey put the number of rental households without air conditioning across the Houston metro at 20,400. But that estimate includes homes outside Houston city limits, so not all of those units would be covered by the ordinance.
The Houston fight is also part of a broader Texas debate. State lawmakers tried to create a statewide requirement for air conditioning in rentals, but that effort stalled amid objections to adding more regulations for property owners.
Some Houston officials expressed similar worries. Mayor John Whitmire said he was "fearful" the rule could increase rents and utility bills, while Council Member Twila Carter said, "My concern is for the people that this policy is intended to protect. This comes at a heavy cost, and it will put people on the streets."
What's being done?
Amy Peck, a council member and realtor, said Houston already requires heat even though it had never required air conditioning. She also said renters often had little recourse when an existing AC unit broke and was not repaired.
The ordinance was backed not just by housing advocates but also by the Houston Apartment Association, and there was no apparent landlord opposition during public hearings.
Julia Orduña of Texas Housers explained, "It comes down to that right to choose how much you're going to pay for electricity. It's not about living with or without AC in your unit, it's about deciding when to turn the AC on and off."
Council Member Alejandra Salinas said, "All Houstonians deserve a right to rest from heat, and that's what this ordinance is going to do."

title: Kenya: Base to Billboardz Artists Gear Up for Album Launch With Exclusive Listening Party
content:
The build-up to the Base to Billboardz collective album continues, as the six artists dubbed "KETEH" took over the Tusker Micro Brewery for an exclusive listening party, giving fans and industry stakeholders a glimpse of what to expect when the album, "Safari Ya Mapenzi," drops at the end of August.
The artists Muringi Matheri, Manasseh Shalom, Zawadi, Chris Barr, Njuguna and Ras Amor, performed original music they have developed through months of mentorship, songwriting, recording and performance training. The session gave guests an opportunity to experience the artists' evolving sounds and the creative direction of the collective project ahead of its official launch.
Speaking at the event, Christine Kariuki, Head of Mainstream Beer at Kenya Breweries Limited (KBL), said:
"It has been inspiring to see how much the artists have grown throughout the Base to Billboardz journey, both individually and as a collective. We are looking forward to the album launch, where audiences will get to experience the full body of work and celebrate the talent, creativity and hard work that has gone into bringing this project to life."
Keep up with the latest headlines on WhatsApp | LinkedIn
The listening party follows the artists' Jam Session performance at K1 Klub House in July, where they performed some of their original music for a live audience as part of their journey through the programme.
The upcoming album, "Safari Ya Mapenzi," marks a major milestone as it captures the artists' growth throughout the programme, from refining their individual craft and experimenting with new sounds to collaborating and creating music as a collective. The six artists were selected from an initial pool of 30 musicians shortlisted by a panel of industry experts including Bien, before public participation and further evaluation led to the formation of the inaugural B2B collective.
B2B is not a traditional music competition. It is a Tusker career accelerator designed to support artists who have already demonstrated momentum through released music, live performance experience, at least one million career streams and a growing fan base. The platform provides mentorship, professional development, recording opportunities and industry exposure to help emerging artists build sustainable music careers.
Since joining the programme, the artists have undergone intensive mentorship and coaching covering vocals, songwriting, dance, performance and the business of music. They have also participated in professional recording sessions, masterclasses and curated industry experiences designed to sharpen their skills and prepare them for the realities of a professional music career.
The journey now moves into its next chapter. The six artists are set to release "Safari Ya Mapenzi" at the end of August, followed by a mega album launch concert open to the public in early September, giving fans the opportunity to experience the collective's new music live. The artists will then take their music to audiences across the country as part of the Oktobafest 2026 tour in October, extending their journey from the studio to the stage.
Through Base to Billboardz, Tusker continues to champion Kenya's creative talent by creating platforms that give emerging artists the opportunity to develop their craft, gain valuable industry experience and build sustainable careers in music.

title: The Independent backs world record CPR attempt in bid to save lives
content:
The Independent backs world record CPR attempt in bid to save lives
The Independent is joining with the Central London Authority in a bid to set a new world record with a life-saving purpose
- Bookmark
- CommentsGo to comments
The Independent is proudly backing an extraordinary world record attempt that could help save thousands of lives and is taking place in London next month.
The initiative from the Central London Alliance (CLA) is aiming to bring thousands of people together on Tuesday 22 and Wednesday 23 September to set a new Guinness World Record for the most people in a CPR relay.
Schools, local businesses, residents, and visitors are invited to take part to help the CLA smash its ambitious target of 4,000 participants, setting a new world record while raising awareness of how you can intervene during cardiac arrest and save a life.
Cardiovascular disease is responsible for around one in four deaths in the UK, with someone suffering a cardiac arrest every three minutes. Fewer than one in 10 people survive an out-of-hospital cardiac arrest. However, if CPR is started by a bystander within the first two minutes, a person's chance of survival increases dramatically, with significantly improved outcomes and a much greater likelihood of avoiding permanent brain injury.
Sharing how a quick-thinking gym owner who knew CPR saved his life, 41-year-old father-to-be Chris Wall said he feels “lucky and blessed” to have been around people who knew how to perform the procedure when he needed it.
He had collapsed mid-class at Catalyst Training in Cirencester, Gloucestershire, in June 2025, but owner Robin Oakley, 39, performed CPR and used a defibrillator, proving crucial in his survival.
“I would not be here today if I wasn’t in that gym class,” Chris said. “I’m just super grateful that I was there and the guys knew what they were doing.”
For CLA Director Nadia Perrier, the campaign is also deeply personal. Four years ago, her husband, Michael, who spent more than 14 years as professional footballer, suffered a sudden cardiac arrest. Despite his exceptional fitness, he was almost pronounced dead at the scene – but his life was saved because one bystander knew how to perform CPR.
"Four years ago, our lives changed forever,” Ms Perrier said. “Michael was a professional athlete, fit and healthy, yet he suffered a sudden cardiac arrest. We were incredibly fortunate that one of his team mates knew CPR. Their quick actions didn't just save Michael's life - they saved my family.”
She added: “I don't think anyone should underestimate what knowing CPR can mean. You may never expect to need those skills, but one day you could be the person standing next to someone you love, a colleague, a stranger or a child, when they desperately need you to know what to do.
“Through this world record attempt, we want to inspire thousands more people to learn and have the confidence to perform CPR. If every participant leaves knowing how to respond in an emergency, the impact of these two days could be felt for generations."
A study also found women are less likely to receive CPR from strangers than men especially in the case of emergencies in a public area.
Businesses, schools, community groups and individuals are all encouraged to register for the event, which takes place on 22 and 23 September at Tower Suites by Blue Orchid Hospitality in London.
How to conduct CPR
• Assess the situation. In order to check whether or not a person is in need of CPR, the first thing you need to do is to gently shake their shoulders while simultaneously asking if they’re alright. You also need to be aware of your surroundings, as you may be in an environment that’s putting you and the unresponsive individual in danger.
• Check they’re breathing. If a person has suffered a cardiac arrest, then they will either not be breathing normally or not be breathing at all. To check whether they're breathing, keep an eye on their chest to see if you can spot any movement while keeping their head tilted back. Listen intently to see if you can hear their breath, and place your face near their mouth to see if you can feel any breath on your cheek.
• Perform chest compressions. Kneel beside the unconscious individual with your knees level with their chest. Place the heel of one of your hands on the centre of their chest, and your other hand on top and interlocking your fingers. Make sure that your shoulders are above your hands before pressing down hard on their chest, straightening your arms and using your entire body weight. The BHF recommends trying to push down by at least five to six centimetres, before releasing and pushing down again. The organisation states that you should aim to give 30 chest compressions at a speed of 100 to 120 chest compressions per minute, which is around two per second.
• Rescue breaths. After carrying out 30 chest compressions, you’ll need to give two rescue breaths if the individual is showing no signs of breathing. Open their airway by placing one hand on their forehead and two fingers under their chin. Then, gently tilt their head back while lifting their chin at the same time. Pinch the soft part of their nose closed, inhale as normal, then, place your mouth on top of theirs and breathe out. Once you’ve done this once, remove your mouth from theirs and carry out the same process again.
• Repeat. Keep repeating the chest compressions and rescue breaths until an ambulance arrives or until the person starts regaining consciousness or breathing properly.

title: Le sergent hesbignon Michaël Robert coordonne les opérations de sauvetage des animaux en Hautes Fagnes : “La situation reste maîtrisée”
content:
Le sergent hesbignon Michaël Robert coordonne les opérations de sauvetage des animaux en Hautes Fagnes : "La situation reste maîtrisée"
Un plan de secours animalier a été activé au sein du Centre de crise provincial de Liège dans le cadre de l'incendie des Hautes Fagnes. Michaël Robert, sergent à la zone de secours Hesbaye, coordonne les opérations avec "Animals rescue team", ces pompiers animaliers.
- Publié le 18-08-2026 à 20h00
Et les animaux sauvages, domestiques, d'élevage qui se trouvent dans ou à proximité de la zone des Hautes Fagnes touchées par un grave incendie qui a ravagé plus de 3000 hectares ? Comment leur venir en aide ? Comment les évacuer ?
Pour tous ces aspects, un plan de secours animalier a été rapidement activé au sein du Centre de crise provincial de Liège. Et c'est Michaël Robert, responsable de l'Animals Rescue Team de la zone de secours Hesbaye, qui en assure la coordination. Il a été désigné comme conseiller technique. Son rôle : évaluer en temps réel la situation et les éventuels besoins sur le terrain.
"C'est le plus grand incendie jamais recensé en Belgique, dans une zone naturelle où la faune et la flore sont directement impactées, souligne le coordinateur. Dans les 24 heures après le déclenchement de l'incendie, on a pris en compte la dimension animalière de la catastrophe."
Situation sous contrôle
Le Hesbignon a donc pris le commandement de la coordination des sauvetages, en partenariat avec l'Animals Rescue Team de Hesbaye et d'autres zones, l'équipe des vétérinaires urgentistes, les ASBL animalières, des bénévoles animaliers, les Creaves (NDLR : Centres de revalidation des espèces vivant à l'état sauvage), le DNF (le département Nature et forêts de la Région wallonne). "À ce stade, la situation est sous contrôle", résume Michaël Robert.
Quatre missions ont été menées au sein de cette cellule : prendre en charge les animaux sauvages blessés, contrôler sur la zone sinistrée les lieux où des bêtes pouvaient éventuellement être coincées ou prisonnières, par des clôtures ou des obstacles par exemple, prendre en charge les animaux de compagnie des personnes évacuées et mettre en sécurité les animaux d'élevage et les chevaux des zones critiques.
Les petits et gros mammifères ont pu s'enfuir calmement
Et c'est l'ART (Animals Rescue Team) de la zone de Hesbaye qui a été mobilisée avec plusieurs hommes, épaulés par les pompiers animaliers d'autres zones : Val de Sambre, Luxembourg, Vesdre Hoëgne & Plateau…
Pour ce qui est de la faune sauvage, la situation est plutôt rassurante, du moins du côté des petits et grands mammifères. "On travaille activement avec le DNF et on peut dire que la situation n'est pas catastrophique. On n'est pas dans le cas de figure des images des incendies en Gironde qui montraient des animaux brûlés sortir de la forêt. Là-bas, les rafales de vent étaient telles que le feu s'est propagé très rapidement, beaucoup de bêtes ont été piégées. Ici, vu la nature du sol, les tourbières, l'incendie, même s'il est très important, avance plus lentement. Les mammifères ont pu s'enfuir sans difficulté vers d'autres territoires."
Des équipes de sauveteurs animaliers ont tourné autour des fronts de flammes pour éventuellement intervenir. "Il n'y a pas vraiment eu besoin mais on était prêts."
Étonnamment et positivement surpris
Les nombreuses patrouilles menées sur le terrain n'ont identifié aucun animal sauvage piégé par les flammes ou en situation de détresse. "J'ai pu observer des groupes de sangliers et des cervidés quitter calmement les zones touchées. On n'a pas non plus observé d'animaux effrayés percutés sur la route par des véhicules. Le bilan est rassurant. On est étonnamment et positivement surpris."
En ce qui concerne la petite faune (amphibiens, insectes, oiseaux, batraciens, rongeurs…), il est encore trop tôt pour faire un bilan. Mais il sera plus lourd. De nombreuses espèces ont sans doute été piégées dans leur terreau, dans le sol, ils se déplacent plus lentement. "Le DNF va devoir réaliser un inventaire de terrain pour évaluer les pertes. Certaines zones n'étaient pas accessibles et dangereuses pour les pompiers, rien n'a pu y être sauvé, on va découvrir les dégâts quand tout sera terminé."
Chats, chiens, cochons d'Inde, oiseaux….
Sur le plan de la prise en charge des animaux domestiques, plusieurs ASBL sont venues en aide aux particuliers. "Ils ont pris en charge des cochons d'Inde, des chiens, des chats, des oiseaux."
Les secours animaliers se tenaient prêts aussi à intervenir chez les agriculteurs proches du sinistre. Au fil des heures, en fonction des vents et des mesures d'évacuation, il fallait s'adapter et anticiper. "On est par exemple intervenu pour 270 bovins concernés par une éventuelle évacuation, raconte le sergent. Un plan de sauvetage a été mis sur pied, on n'a heureusement pas dû l'activer." Les animaux de ferme et les chevaux ont pu être évacués et mis en sécurité par leurs propriétaires, sans difficulté constatée. "Notre travail a surtout été préventif."
Des milliers de propositions d'aide
Le sergent hesbignon souligne la mobilisation importante de toutes les sections animalières des zones de secours et du travail collaboratif efficace qui est réalisé.
Il souligne aussi l'aspect humain de ce plan de sauvetage de grande ampleur: beaucoup d'émotion et de solidarité du côté des professionnels mais aussi de la part de très nombreux citoyens prêts à aider. "On veut remercier toutes ces personnes qui ont proposé d'accueillir des animaux chez eux, dans leurs prairies, qui nous appelaient pour offrir de la nourriture pour les bêtes, des cages, des points d'eau… On a reçu des milliers de propositions, c'est un bel élan citoyen."
